changelog: WhatsApp messages now send immediately on their own — no cron and no 'Send pending now' needed. A new 'Send messages immediately' switch (on by default) flushes the queue right after each action, so order confirmations, OTPs and status updates go instantly.
WhatsApp Status-check panel updated to show Auto-send is on and no longer warns about the cron when it isn't needed.
Public website redesign, order-only (no prices), track-by-mobile, category icons and the UTC-database timezone fix (from 1.0.3).
